description: This bar chart illustrates the computational cost, measured in Giga FLOPS, of different module types across three stages of an audio back-end Conformer. The horizontal axis, labeled “Audio back-end Conformer Stage”, lists the categories “Stage 1 (d=180, n=500)”, “Stage 2 (d=256, n=250)”, and “Stage 3 (d=360, n=125)” in that order, appearing to be sequentially numbered. The vertical axis is labeled “Module FLOPS” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.3, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05.  For each stage, there are four bars representing different module types: “attention” (blue), “grouped attention (g=3)” (red), “patch attention (k=3)” (yellow), and “feed-forward” (green). In Stage 1, the ‘attention’ bar reaches approximately 0.28, the ‘grouped attention’ bar reaches approximately 0.15, the ‘patch attention’ bar reaches approximately 0.17, and the ‘feed-forward’ bar reaches approximately 0.11. In Stage 2, the ‘attention’ bar extends to approximately 0.16, ‘grouped attention’ to approximately 0.13, ‘patch attention’ to approximately 0.11, and ‘feed-forward’ to approximately 0.15.  In Stage 3, the ‘attention’ bar reaches approximately 0.12, ‘grouped attention’ to approximately 0.11, ‘patch attention’ to approximately 0.10, and ‘feed-forward’ to approximately 0.16. Within each stage, the bars representing the different module types are grouped together.  The bars are sorted by stage number, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
